Step 6: Using the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, we can write \[(300 \cos \theta - 468 \sin \theta) + \frac{24}{\cos \theta} + \frac{36}{\sin \theta} \geq 2 \sqrt{(300 \cos \theta - 468 \sin \theta) \left(\frac{24}{\cos \theta} + \frac{36}{\sin \theta}\right)}.\]

Step 7: Simplifying the expression, we get \[2 \sqrt{(300 \cos \theta - 468 \sin \theta) \left(\frac{24}{\cos \theta} + \frac{36}{\sin \theta}\right)} = 2 \sqrt{7200 \cos^2 \theta - 10464 \sin^2 \theta + 5760 \cos \theta + 1296 \sin \theta}.\]

Step 9: Completing the square, we can write \[7200 \cos^2 \theta - 10464 \sin^2 \theta + 5760 \cos \theta + 1296 \sin \theta = 7200(\cos^2 \theta - \frac{468}{300} \sin^2 \theta) + 5760 \cos \theta + 1296 \sin \theta.\]

Step 14: Factoring out the common term, we get \[7200(\cos^2 \theta - \frac{156}{25} \sin^2 \theta + \frac{1}{5}) + 5760 \cos \theta + 1296 \sin \theta - 2304 = 7200(\cos^2 \theta - \frac{156}{25} \sin^2 \theta + \frac{1}{5}) + 5760(\cos \theta + \frac{24}{25} \sin \theta) + 1296(\sin \theta - \frac{24}{25} \cos \theta) - 2304.\]
